title: Media
description: DataViews grid + table view of the media library, with an upload affordance above the mount and a host-agnostic MediaDetails metadata editor that hosts an inline crop / rotate / flip image editor in its preview slot. Reads via `core-data` `'root','media'` entity.

variant.description: Optional DataView variant id resolved to `settings.dataViews.root.media.<variant>`.

documentation.purpose: Media library DataViews host over the `root/media` entity. Default grid layout renders an image thumbnail (or a labeled file-type tile for non-image attachments) per attachment via the `thumbnail` media field; table layout offers sortable Title / Type / Author / Date columns. An upload control sits in a toolbar ABOVE the DataViews mount (multipart `apiFetch`, per-file try/catch). The Edit action opens the host-agnostic `MediaDetails` component (entity-bound `DataForm` over title / alt-text — images only / caption / description) inside a DataViews RenderModal; its preview slot offers an Edit Image affordance for image attachments that swaps in the inline `ImageEditor` (crop / rotate / flip on a canvas, saved via `POST /wp/v2/media/{id}/edit` which returns a NEW attachment the host then re-points to). Copy URL writes the source URL to the clipboard. Delete (single + bulk) permanently removes the attachment (`force: true` — media has no trash).

reads.purpose: Resolved DataView doc — fields, default view, default layouts, actions. Read via `useDataView(screenId)`; baseline ships in `app.json#dataView` and is injected post-merge by `inject_app_baselines`.

query.media_type: filter:type (single-select `is` — media_type is a single-value enum)
query.author: filter:author (single-select `is`) | mine toolbar toggle
query._embed: author (resolves the Author column display name)

reads.purpose: Per-type totals for the media-type filter ("Images (12)"). One lightweight request per type via `useEntityElementCounts`; totals come from the X-WP-Total header.

Author options for the `author` filter. DataViews resolves the field's `getElements` lazily when the filter opens — one `resolveSelect(getEntityRecords)` over `root/user` (who=authors, per_page=100, `_fields=id,name`), mapped to `{ value: id, label: name }` and cached after the first open.
Single attachment buffered through `useEntityRecord` inside `MediaDetails` for metadata editing.

writes.purpose: Multipart upload: `FormData` with `file` field, POST to `/wp/v2/media`. One request per file; per-file try/catch.
Edit attachment metadata (title / alt_text / caption / description) via the `MediaDetails` `DataForm` + buffered `useEntityRecord().save()`.
Permanently delete attachment(s) (`force: true` — media has no trash). Single + bulk via `createBulkConfirmModal`.

Inline image editor (`ImageEditor.js`). POSTs `{ src, modifiers:[{type:'rotate'|'flip'|'crop', args}] }` to the attachments controller's `/edit` route. Crop/rotate/flip only (scale / per-size target / restore / in-place are admin-ajax-only — see docs/parity/media.md blockers #1-#4). The response is a BRAND-NEW attachment (the route always inserts a new post); `onSaved(newAttachment)` bubbles the new id so the host re-points (`MediaDetailsModal` switches `editingId` to it). The pure REST-contract mapping (rotation/flip/crop → ordered `modifiers[]`) lives in `imageEditorModel.mjs`, pinned by `tests/runtime/image-editor-model.test.mjs`.

states.renders: Centered Spinner covering the panel (gate before the first response — DataViews mounts only once records arrive).
DataViews grid (thumbnail tiles) or table; DataViews owns its own empty + paging + per-filter loading states.
Upload button shows loading + disabled; new items appear after invalidation.

states.when: User clicked Edit on a row
states.renders: DataViews RenderModal hosting `MediaDetails` — preview slot (left) + metadata DataForm (right) + Save / Copy URL / Delete actions. For images, the preview shows an Edit Image button.

states.when: User clicked Edit Image in MediaDetails (image attachment only)
states.renders: `ImageEditor` replaces the static preview: a canvas preview (composes rotate → flip → crop in REST-apply order) + a rotate-left / rotate-right / flip-H / flip-V / crop toolbar + a draggable, corner-resizable crop overlay + Cancel / Save a copy. Save a copy is disabled until a real edit exists.

interactions.effect: `view.filters` updates → `buildQueryArgs` maps the single-select `is` operator to `media_type` (a single-value REST enum: image / video / audio / text / application) → records refetch.

`view.filters` updates → `buildQueryArgs` maps the single-select `is` operator to REST `author` (scalar user id) → records refetch. Options resolve lazily via the field's `getElements` provider (fetches content authors through core-data, cached after first open). When an author filter is active it is the SINGLE author scope: the Mine static `author` arg is skipped, and the Mine toggle shows checked only when the filter's value equals the current user id.

`view.filters` updates → a supplemental `applyDateFilters` pass maps the `before`/`after` operators to the attachments controller's REST `before`/`after` ISO params (`buildQueryArgs` only speaks `is`/`isAny`) → records refetch. One-sided date bound (`before X` OR `after Y`, not a two-ended range — DataViews holds one filter per field).

interactions.trigger: Page through results / change the Type filter
interactions.effect: `view.page` and the single-value `type` filter mirror to the URL (`?paged=N`, `?media_type=<value>`) via the `urlSlots` opt-in on `useEntityDataView` — refresh / deep-link / browser-back restore the page + filter. `?paged` is omitted on page 1; the slots merge onto the live hash so an unrelated slot (`?screen=`) is preserved.

interactions.trigger: Type in the DataViews search box
interactions.effect: `view.search` → REST `search` (matches title + filename via the attachments controller).

Mine → `author={currentUserId}`; Unattached → `parent=0`; merged into the query. Mine and the author dropdown filter share the author axis: toggling Mine (ON or OFF) drops any active author dropdown filter, Mine's checked state is derived from the active author scope rather than a standalone boolean, and a `useEffect` keyed on the active-author-filter flag clears the underlying `showMine` whenever a dropdown author filter becomes active — so the two controls are fully symmetric (one author scope at a time, no contradiction, no latent `showMine` resurfacing own media when the dropdown filter is later cleared, no inert toggle).
Open hidden `<input type="file" multiple>`. On file pick, iterate + POST each via `apiFetch` with FormData; invalidate after ≥1 succeeds.
Open the `MediaDetails` RenderModal for that attachment.
Buffered `useEntityRecord().save()` commits title / alt_text / caption / description; invalidate the list resolution; close modal.

Swap the static preview for the inline `ImageEditor`. Rotate / flip buttons mutate transform state; the Crop toggle shows a draggable + corner-resizable selection. The canvas repaints on every change, composing rotate → flip → crop in the same order the controller applies them (so the preview equals the saved result).

interactions.trigger: Save a copy in the image editor
interactions.effect: `buildModifiers` builds the ordered `modifiers[]` (rotate → flip → crop, no-ops dropped); `apiFetch` POSTs them with `src` to `/wp/v2/media/{id}/edit`. The route returns a NEW attachment — a success snackbar fires, the list invalidates, and the host re-points the open detail to the new id (`onReplaced`). Crop percentages are read against the canvas (post-rotation bounding box), matching what the controller multiplies against.
`navigator.clipboard.writeText(item.source_url)`; success snackbar (or error notice on clipboard denial).
`createBulkConfirmModal` confirms, then `deleteEntityRecord('root','media', id, { force: true })` per target; invalidate list + counts; report partial failures.

a11y.focus-management: DataViews owns focus inside the grid / table + RenderModal. The RenderModal contract restores focus to the action trigger on close. `MediaDetails` is keyed `item.id` so per-item buffer resets between openings. Image-editor crop gap: the `ImageEditor` crop selection (box + corner handles) is pointer-only — the elements are `role="presentation"` divs/spans with no keyboard affordance, so keyboard/AT users can move/resize the crop only with a pointer. Rotate / flip remain fully keyboard-operable (focusable buttons). Not a regression vs. classic wp-admin (its crop is also mouse-driven). A future improvement: make the box focusable and nudge crop geometry via arrow keys through the same `moveCrop`/`resizeCrop` helpers.
a11y.screen-reader: Image-editor rotate buttons are not toggles: the rotate-left / rotate-right tool buttons are momentary actions and emit NO `aria-pressed` (only the genuine toggles — flip-H, flip-V, crop — do), so a screen reader doesn't announce them as toggle buttons stuck unpressed.

constraints.note: `defaultView.mediaField` (`thumbnail`) + `titleField` (`title`) + `sort` are declared COMPLETELY in this app.json so a workspace that redeclares `root/media/_default` and omits them doesn't drop the baseline (the CLAUDE.md redeclaration trap).
Media has no trash. `deleteEntityRecord` requires `{ force: true }` or the request 400s.

The `author` filter is `is`-only with options supplied by a `getElements` provider (fetches content authors via core-data, `who=authors`). The field `type` is `text` to match the rendered cell (the embedded author display name); the filter `value` is the numeric user id, which the `is` operator passes straight to REST `author`. The date filter wires `before`/`after` via `applyDateFilters` since `buildQueryArgs` only speaks `is`/`isAny` (mirrors the Posts lane).
Upload uses `apiFetch` with a `FormData` body — the documented exception to the core-data rule. `saveEntityRecord` doesn't handle multipart well.

Metadata editing lives in `MediaDetails.js`, decoupled from the DataViews RenderModal host. The #125 image editor lands in its preview slot; a future inspector / side-pane (#136) can host it unchanged.

`POST /wp/v2/media/{id}/edit` ALWAYS creates a new attachment (no in-place REST mode — docs/parity/media.md blocker #1). The editor surfaces this ('Saves a copy — the original is kept') and the new id bubbles up via `onSaved`/`onReplaced` so the host re-points; callers must not assume the id is stable across an edit.

Only crop / rotate / flip are wired — the `/edit` `modifiers[]` enum supports no others (scale / per-size target / restore / in-place are admin-ajax-only). Modifiers are emitted in REST-apply order (rotate → flip → crop) so the canvas preview equals the saved output; the pure mapping is tested in `imageEditorModel.mjs`.

The `/edit` POST uses `apiFetch` (the edit route is an action returning a new attachment, not a standard entity update) — the same documented exception as multipart upload. The canvas only DRAWS the source (never reads pixels back), so a tainted cross-origin (CDN) image still previews.

design-system-leakage.purpose: DataViews (grid + table, filtering / sorting / pagination / selection / per-row + bulk actions / RenderModal) + DataForm (MediaDetails metadata form).
Upload toolbar + MediaDetails layout + action buttons + the image editor's canvas/crop UI + inline error Notice.
Destructive delete + records-null spinner gate + Mine / Unattached toggles — WPDS 0.12 gaps.

design-system-leakage.import: @wordpress/icons#upload, trash, copy, edit, crop, rotateLeft, rotateRight, flipHorizontal, flipVertical
design-system-leakage.purpose: Action + toolbar icons (registered in the core-default engine icon table); the crop / rotate / flip set is the image-editor toolbar.
Multipart upload + the inline image-editor `POST /wp/v2/media/{id}/edit` (both documented non-entity exceptions to the core-data rule).
Success / error snackbars + banners for upload / save / delete flows.
